name: Goldsmiths, University of London

facts.text: Goldsmiths delivers its research and teaching from the heart of South East London (New Cross).
For more than 200 years, generations of students have received an education on the site of Goldsmiths.
Goldsmiths offers study options across a range of disciplines from the arts and humanities to business and management.
Goldsmiths runs a free public art gallery (Goldsmiths Centre for Contemporary Art) bringing world-class exhibitions to south London.

sources.notes: This is the undergraduate ADMISSIONS (course-selection) interview advice page, not a credibility/pre-CAS interview page. Only relevant line: 'If you're an international student then you will most likely be interviewed via a video call.' No credibility-interview topics or questions. The international page https://www.gold.ac.uk/international/ was also fetched and contains nothing on credibility interviews, pre-CAS, CAS Shield or Enroly. No student report naming Goldsmiths was found.
